method: SAM 3D Body (sam_3d_body_dinov3_bf16, ComfyUI core nodes) on each frame, whole frame as the box, hand refinement on; SAM3DBody_Smooth savgol window 7; BVH via BuildPoseFile, camera translation off. Made with: python h3band/sam3d_mocap.py work/sam3d/clips/X.mp4 work/sam3d/X --fps F. Each clip is a cut of one static-camera shot (ffmpeg scene detection at threshold 0.12 and contact sheets), scaled to 960x540 so ComfyUI's LoadVideo holds it in memory.
note: carey_a-c are one shot (440.3-534.2 s), carey_d-e another (255.6-313.2 s), cut in pieces for memory; concert lighting (purple, strobing) throughout
